summary: Read-only table getter. Reads the state selector from this[4450] (dword at byte offset 0x4588), normalizes it to a 1-based index, selects a base dword index of 1113, and returns the dword table entry at dword index (4 * base), i.e. this[4 * ((selector - 1 < 0) ? 1113 : 1113 + selector - 1)]. Invoked by sub_4A4110, EngineFailureCheck and AIBehaviorInitialization.

local_names.this: owner object holding the state selector and the dword lookup table
local_names.selector: state selector stored at this[4450] (byte offset 0x4588)

operations.description: Load the state selector from this[4450], the dword at byte offset 0x4588.
Selection guard: when (selector - 1) < 0 the base table index is 1113; otherwise the base is 1113 + selector - 1.
Effective dword address = 4 * base, indexing this at dword index 1113 or 1113 + selector - 1.
Return the dword entry at this[4 * base]; when the selector is 0 or negative this is the entry at dword index 1113.
Invoked by sub_4A4110 (004A4110), EngineFailureCheck (004BEC55) and AIBehaviorInitialization (004BF0A0) to fetch a per-state flag/selector value.

clean_pseudocode: int state = this[4450]; /* dword at byte offset 0x4588 */
unresolved: The returned dword table (entries starting at dword index 1113) has unknown length and element semantics; only the single selector field at 0x4588 is captured by the packet.
Whether dword index 1113 corresponds to a default/sentinel state when the selector is 0 or negative is not provable from this packet alone.
